request.description: The firm owner hands an accepted lead to an active member of the firm (or back to themselves). The member then sees it in their inbox. Firm owner only. Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.
